tools.name: createSalesOrder
tools.description: Create a sales order in NetSuite. entity (customer), otherrefnum (PO#), and at least one item are mandatory. itemIds and quantities must be parallel arrays of the same length — the item at position N in itemIds corresponds to the quantity at position N in quantities.

entity.description: The internal ID of the customer for the sales order

otherrefnum.description: The purchase order number associated with the sales order, it must be unique for each sales order.

itemIds.description: Comma-separated list of internal item IDs to include on the sales order, in order. Example: '3021,3044,3050'

quantities.description: Comma-separated list of quantities, parallel to itemIds by position. Example: '5,2,10'
